title: guenthera repanda subsp. humilis
intro: Guenthera repanda subsp. humilis, commonly known as Himalayan sweet cicely, is a plant species belonging to the family Apiaceae. It is traditionally used to aid digestion and has been found to have various health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Guenthera repanda subsp. humilis include stimulating digestive enzymes, soothing digestive issues, and exhibiting anti-anxiety effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include phenolic compounds, essential oils, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
